scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3002/health http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron . --dev"
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install
scripts.dist:win: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.dist:linux: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --linux AppImage
